name: Employee Onboarding
description: Triggered when a signed offer letter and NDA are received. Fans out to HR, IT, and Finance lanes simultaneously.

config.message: NEW HIRE — {{employee_name}} starts {{start_date}}. Please greet them on arrival, plan first-day lunch, and brief them on their role. HR will schedule an onboarding meeting.

config.title: Run E-Verify — {{employee_name}}
config.body: E-Verify must be completed within 3 business days of {{employee_name}}'s start date ({{start_date}}). Log in to e-verify.uscis.gov and complete verification manually. Paylocity integration is not used.

config.title: Assign UTA card — {{employee_name}} (Utah employees only)
config.body: If {{employee_name}} is a Utah-based employee, assign them a UTA transit card. Coordinate with HR for card issuance.

config.title: Confirm background check cleared — {{employee_name}}
config.body: Verify the background check authorization has been received and results are cleared before or by {{employee_name}}'s start date ({{start_date}}).

config.title: Reserve conference room — {{employee_name}} onboarding on {{start_date}}
config.body: Reserve a conference room for the new hire onboarding meeting for {{employee_name}}. Remind the hiring manager to take them to lunch on their first day.

config.message: NEW HIRE ONBOARDING — {{employee_name}} | Role: {{job_title}} | Start: {{start_date}}. Please complete IT setup: computer, M365 account, licenses, and workspace (desk if local / shipping if remote).

config.title: IT Computer Setup — {{employee_name}} (start: {{start_date}})
config.body: Set up laptop/workstation for {{employee_name}}. Install OS, company software, AV, MDM enrollment, and configure AD login. Have device ready before start date.

config.title: Create M365 account — {{employee_name}}
config.body: Create Microsoft 365 account for {{employee_name}}. Set up email, Teams, SharePoint access. Username format per policy. Account must be ready before start date {{start_date}}.

config.title: Assign software licenses — {{employee_name}}
config.body: Assign M365 license tier and any role-specific software licenses for {{employee_name}}. Coordinate with hiring manager for software needed for the role.

config.title: Assign desk/workspace — {{employee_name}} (local)
config.body: Assign a desk and workspace to {{employee_name}} for start date {{start_date}}. Ensure chair, monitor, keyboard, and peripherals are in place. Notify hiring manager of desk location.

config.title: Ship equipment — {{employee_name}} (remote)
config.body: Generate a prepaid shipping label and ship the configured laptop and peripherals to {{employee_name}} at their home address. Confirm delivery before start date {{start_date}}.

config.message: NEW HIRE — {{employee_name}} | Dept Code: {{department_code}} | Salary: {{salary}} | Start: {{start_date}}. Please order a Divvy card.

config.title: Order Divvy card — {{employee_name}}
config.body: Order a Divvy card for {{employee_name}}. Department code: {{department_code}}. Configure spending limits per company policy before start date {{start_date}}.

config.title: Complete Paylocity onboarding — {{employee_name}}
config.body:
Enter {{employee_name}} into Paylocity:
- Personal info, address, SSN
- Direct deposit / banking info
- Salary/rate and department code: {{department_code}}
- Tax withholding (W-4)
- Benefits enrollment
- Start date: {{start_date}}
